description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Select how FSLogix should enable logging. All logs is the default setting.

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Logging\LoggingEnabled
Values:  0 = No Logs, 1 = Specific Logs, 2 = All Logs
